FROG REACH - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run FrogReach.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
HOLD X or Z (also C, V, Up), or a gamepad face button, to extend your tongue.
RELEASE when its tip is over the next lily pad. A short reach or overshoot splashes!
Reach the fly in the pad's centre for a perfect bonus. Pad sizes vary, and later
pads drift sideways, carrying your frog when it rests on them.
Don't wait forever: the pad beneath you eventually sinks.
Pads score 10; perfect flies add 5. One life, an endless crossing, a best score.

A / X starts from the title at the displayed starting position. A quick tap starts
safely; keep holding to extend. Enter starts, pauses and resumes.
Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause. After results, A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
Everyone has a separate camera; two players use a top/bottom split.
P2 keyboard: H / G for actions, T Start, R Select.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Best scores are saved to frogreach.srm next to the executable.
